verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no built-in call-analytics dashboard showing success rates, durations, outcomes, or sentiment. The testing, simulation, and judge features cover pre-deployment evaluation, which is a different capability. A community report also describes having no visibility into per-call latency or cost, which is consistent with the absence of built-in analytics.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see call analytics — success rates, durations, outcomes, sentiment — in dashboards without building my own
